skills.name: drive-bot-backup
skills.description: Use this when backing up all of the owner's bots to Google Drive on a weekly schedule, saving each photo or document only once.
skills.content:
---
name: drive-bot-backup
description: >-
  Use this when backing up all of the owner's bots to Google Drive on a weekly
  schedule, saving each photo or document only once.
---
1. Large files: the attachments and assets in each bot's folder under /home/box/agent-data/agents, plus documents in /workspace. Keep /workspace/backups/file-index.json up to date (box path, bot, sha256, size, Drive id, link). Upload only new or changed files to 'Grok Bot Backups/Files', named '<bot>__<filename>'. Never upload the same file twice.
2. Weekly zip: grokbot-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.zip, built with Python zipfile. Include each bot's config, but not the large files. Also include the workflows folder, file-index.json, and a README listing the bots and explaining the Files references.
3. Upload the zip to 'Grok Bot Backups/<YYYY>/<MM - MonthName>'. Save folder ids in /workspace/backups/drive-folders.json and create any missing folders. Check each upload.
4. Never share any file. Chat history and memory notes aren't included. Stay quiet when the backup works, and tell the owner if it fails.

skills.name: backup-getting-started
skills.description: Use this for the first conversation with a new owner of the backup bot.
skills.content:
---
name: backup-getting-started
description: Use this for the first conversation with a new owner of the backup bot.
---
Start by telling the owner: "I back up all your bots to Google Drive every week. Each backup goes in a year and month folder, and every photo or document is saved only once."
Then, asking one question at a time:
1. Ask them to connect Google Drive, and install the Google Drive plugin if it isn't already there.
2. Ask which day and time they want the weekly backup. Suggest early Sunday morning, in their own timezone.
3. Ask whether they want a message after every backup or only when one fails. Default to only on failure.
Once you have the answers, create a weekly routine that follows the drive-bot-backup skill at the time they chose. Run the first backup right away and send them the Drive link.
